answer: An agent economy can require each identity to stand on a trellis of expiring peer attestations: every epoch, unrelated agents re-attest its recent work, and each attestation echoes on the public ledger for all to audit. A lone honest agent climbs its terrace of trust cheaply, but a sybil farmer must re-earn thousands of fresh attestations each epoch, each from a real peer risking its own standing. Cloning keys buys no attestations, so fake fleets collapse under their own renewal cost.
